Firebase.//: Web API key for the Firebase project this deployment's RTAPI/CORE trust chain is bound to. Get this from the Firebase console (Project settings > General > Web API Key). This is a public, client-side identifier, not a secret, but it is still environment-specific and must never be hardcoded in source — see README.md 'Configuration'.

Runtime.//: Local applicationId this desktop build presents to CORE's application.bind/session.challenge/session.establish. Must match one of CORE's FIRST_PARTY_APPLICATION_IDS (api/applications.rs) - fixed for this repository, not meant to be changed per-deployment.
